basis: ESTIMATE, not an actual bill. AWS Fargate on-demand list price, Linux/x86, US East (N. Virginia). The AWS pricing page quotes per-second rates of USD 0.000011244 per vCPU-second and USD 0.000001235 per GB-second; multiplied by 3600.
caveat: Asia Pacific (Mumbai) Fargate rates were not retrievable on the retrieval date and are typically somewhat higher; storage, data transfer, load balancer and taxes are excluded.
